classScaffold.baseline: Basic attack, basic off-heal, baseline personal defense and resurrection/group utility policies remain separate design decisions, not additional nodes here.

Evoker/Augmentation.description: Augmentation Evoker baseline based on remembered retail WoW talents, primarily from the Dragonflight / The War Within era. Not verified against Wowhead or current Midnight data. Positions, connections, ranks and summarized effects are editable approximations, not an official build. Uses this workbook's 34/34/4/13 point budgets. Hero section represents Chronowarden only; Scalecommander is not included. Apex is intentionally empty pending verified data.

nodes.name: Natural Convergence

nodes.name: Aerial Mastery

nodes.name: Exuberance

nodes.name: Time Spiral

nodes.name: Zephyr

Priest/Thaumaturgy.description: Homebrew ranged support Priest: an esoteric scholar of hidden correspondences, true names and spiritual fault lines. Mind Sear: Communion connects you to two chosen allies, sharing your perception of enemy weaknesses rather than increasing allied stats. Mind Flay gathers Insight and sustains Unveil Weakness; Mind Blast spends Insight to exploit it. Offensive vulnerabilities benefit you and your connected allies, not the entire party. Uses the Augmentation baseline's exact class/spec/hero node positions, ranks and connection graph, with Priest utility and original occult mechanics. All values are provisional design numbers, not official WoW talents or tested balance. Apex remains open for later design.

nodes.name: Psychic Scream
nodes.description: Release a psychic cry that causes up to 5 nearby enemies to flee for 8 seconds. Damage may break the effect. Revealing a weakness does not require the enemy to be susceptible to fear.

nodes.name: Power Word: Shield
nodes.description: Place a protective word upon an ally, absorbing damage for 15 seconds. A familiar Priest rite, not an increase to the ally's offensive stats.

nodes.name: Purify
nodes.description: Remove harmful Magic and Disease effects from a friendly target. This support-spec cleanse is a homebrew allocation, not a claim about retail Priest access.

nodes.name: Ritual Cadence
nodes.description: Mind Flay's channel time is reduced by 10%, retaining all 3 ticks and their Insight generation. Understanding grows through repetition.

nodes.name: Lingering Suggestion
nodes.description: Mind Flay slows its target by 30% during the channel and for 2 seconds afterward. Bosses retain their normal immunity to movement impairment.

nodes.name: Layered Wards
nodes.description: Power Word: Shield gains a second charge. Its absorb effects do not stack on the same target.

nodes.name: Benediction of the Inner Light
nodes.description: Speak a restorative formula that immediately heals a friendly target. The rite mends the vessel without changing its offensive potential.

nodes.name: Illuminated Verses
nodes.description: Increase Smite damage and Flash Heal healing by 5% / 10%.

nodes.name: Silence
nodes.description: Interrupt the target and prevent spellcasting for 4 seconds. Against silence-immune enemies, interrupt their current cast instead.

nodes.name: Veiled Steps
nodes.description: Fade increases your movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds. The world loosens its hold on your passing.

nodes.name: Doctrine of Exchange
nodes.description: Effective healing you deal accumulates a reserve equal to 10% of that healing, capped at 20% of your maximum health. Your next Mind Blast consumes the reserve as additional personal damage. This reserve cannot record damage or echoes.

nodes.name: Litany of Unmaking
nodes.description: Recite a disquieting litany in a cone. Up to 5 enemies become susceptible to 20% longer crowd-control effects for 10 seconds. Does not bypass immunities or increase damage taken.

nodes.name: Exorcism of Affliction
nodes.description: Remove one Curse and one Poison effect from an ally. An esoteric supplement to Purify, not a universal cleanse.

nodes.name: Vessel of the Mystery
nodes.description: Increase your maximum health by 3% / 6%.

nodes.name: Apotropaic Inscriptions
nodes.description: Reduce magical damage taken by 2% / 4%. Protective signs turn hostile workings aside.

nodes.name: Shared Benediction
nodes.description: Benediction of the Inner Light also heals up to 2 injured party allies within 10 yards of its target for 25% of its healing each.

nodes.name: Sever the Frenzy
nodes.description: Litany of Unmaking removes one Enrage effect from each affected enemy. Each successful removal reduces its remaining cooldown by 3 seconds, up to 15 seconds per cast.

nodes.name: Rite of Reconstitution
nodes.description: For 8 seconds, record 30% of damage you actually take, up to 30% of your maximum health. Restore that amount over the following 6 seconds. The rite cannot prevent a fatal blow.

nodes.name: Leap of Faith
nodes.description: Pull a friendly party or raid member to your location. The familiar Priest rescue replaces the Evoker's flight-based rescue.

nodes.name: Dreadful Revelation
nodes.description: Litany of Unmaking briefly disorients affected non-boss enemies for 2 seconds. Damage breaks this disorient.

nodes.name: Unbroken Procession
nodes.description: Increase the duration of Veiled Steps by 1 / 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Immediate Recollection
nodes.description: Rite of Reconstitution restores its recorded damage continuously during its active window instead of waiting for that window to end. Its total healing limit remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Twin Seals
nodes.description: Leap of Faith grants you and its target an absorb equal to 10% of your respective maximum health for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Physician of the Soul
nodes.description: Healing another target with Benediction of the Inner Light also heals you for 30% of its effective primary healing. This self-healing cannot trigger another Benediction.

nodes.name: Contagious Revelation
nodes.description: After a completed Mind Flay channel, your next Smite also strikes up to 2 nearby enemies for 40% damage each. This bonus is consumed by one cast and does not stack.

nodes.name: Passage Beyond Notice
nodes.description: Fade gains a second charge. Movement and defensive effects of consecutive Fades refresh rather than stack.

nodes.name: Compassionate Clarity
nodes.description: Flash Heal and Benediction of the Inner Light make your next Smite or Mind Blast cast 25% faster. Lasts 10 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: Enduring Inscription
nodes.description: Increase Shadow Word: Pain's duration by 3 / 6 seconds without increasing its tick rate.

nodes.name: Serene Bearing
nodes.description: While above 80% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.

nodes.name: Dispel Magic
nodes.description: Remove one beneficial Magic effect from an enemy. Stripping a protection reveals what lies beneath it.

nodes.name: Procession of the Unseen
nodes.description: For 8 seconds, party allies within 30 yards ignore movement slows and may move through hostile units. Does not grant immunity to roots, stuns or other loss of control, and does not increase stats.

nodes.name: Hermetic Focus
nodes.description: Your next Mind Blast within 10 seconds is instant, costs no Insight and consumes no charge. It still pays its Mana cost and still extends an active Unveil Weakness normally.

nodes.name: Circle of Abjuration
nodes.description: Create a ward at your location for 8 seconds. Party allies within 10 yards take 15% less area damage. Only the strongest Circle of Abjuration affects an ally.

nodes.name: Walking Meditation
nodes.description: For 8 seconds, you can channel Mind Flay and cast Mind Blast while moving. Does not grant casting movement to other players or change spell range.

nodes.name: Many-Fold Scripture
nodes.description: Contagious Revelation's Smite cleave affects 1 additional enemy. Secondary hits cannot produce further cleaves.

nodes.name: Unfailing Thread
nodes.description: Reduce Leap of Faith's cooldown by 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Mass Dispel
nodes.description: Dispel one harmful Magic effect from up to 5 allies and one beneficial Magic effect from up to 5 enemies in the targeted area. This draft retains the recognizable Priest utility.

nodes.name: Purity of Intention
nodes.description: Reduce Mass Dispel's Mana cost by 25% and its cast time by 0.5 seconds. This node also grants Mass Dispel if its own node is not selected; selecting both grants no additional copy or bonus.

nodes.name: Unveil Weakness
nodes.description: Read the hidden fault lines of an enemy and up to 4 nearest enemies within 8 yards. For 12 seconds they take 6% increased damage from you and your eligible Mind Sear: Communion allies, including their pets. Unlinked players do not benefit. Mind Blast and completed Mind Flay channels extend your active revelation, up to 20 seconds remaining. Duplicate copies do not stack; total vulnerability is capped at 15% per attacker and enemy. Baseline spell: Mind Sear: Communion instantly connects a living party or raid ally for 30 seconds, costs Mana, has 40-yard range and 2 charges with sequential 12-second recharge, and uses the global cooldown. Maximum 2 linked allies; recasting refreshes a link, a third ally replaces the oldest. Beyond 60 yards benefits pause while the timer continues; death or leaving the group ends the link. You always benefit without using a slot. This is a homebrew ally-link reinterpretation of the historical Priest spell, not its retail effect.

nodes.name: Mind Blast
nodes.description: Spend 2 Insight to strike a revealed fault with Shadow damage. Extend your existing Unveil Weakness on the target by 2 seconds, up to its duration cap. Can be cast on an unmarked enemy, but does not apply Unveil Weakness. Two charges, each recharging in 9 seconds.

nodes.name: Mind Flay
nodes.description: Channel Shadow damage into an enemy's consciousness over 3 seconds, dealing 3 ticks before haste and generating 1 Insight per tick. Completing all 3 ticks extends your active Unveil Weakness on that target by 1 second, up to its duration cap. Interrupted channels retain Insight already earned but grant no completion extension.

nodes.name: Ward of Correspondence
nodes.description: Inscribe an ally with 6 ward charges for 30 seconds. A direct hostile hit consumes a charge, reduces that hit's damage by 10%, and deals personal Shadow retaliation to the attacker. At most one charge triggers per second. Retaliation cannot trigger or feed echoes. Only one ally may bear your ward; recasting replaces it.

nodes.name: Sudden Gnosis
nodes.description: Each Mind Flay tick has a 10% / 20% chance to make your next Mind Blast cost no Insight. Lasts 10 seconds and does not stack. It still consumes a charge unless another effect explicitly prevents this.

nodes.name: Occult Diagnosis
nodes.description: Identify a precise weakness in one enemy, increasing damage it takes from you and your eligible Communion allies by an additional 3% for 10 seconds. Independent of Unveil Weakness, with the same contributor eligibility and 15% combined cap. Only one target may bear your Diagnosis; recasting replaces it. Two charges recharge sequentially.

nodes.name: Sympathetic Fracture
nodes.description: Mind Blast also strikes up to 2 nearby enemies bearing your Unveil Weakness for 20% / 40% of its direct damage. Secondary hits extend their existing revelation by 1 second but generate no additional cleaves or echoes.

nodes.name: Seal of Preservation
nodes.description: Applying Ward of Correspondence grants its bearer an absorb equal to 10% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Reapplications replace rather than stack this absorb. This node also grants the base Ward ability if its node is not selected.

nodes.name: Chamber of Insight
nodes.description: Increase your maximum Insight from 6 to 8. Mind Flay remains the reliable source of Insight; no Insanity or Voidform cycle is used.

nodes.name: Grand Conjunction
nodes.description: Draw a great sigil beneath an enemy and up to 4 nearest enemies within 8 yards for 10 seconds. They take an additional 2% damage from you and your eligible Communion allies. Record 10% of those contributors' direct damage before Thaumaturgy bonuses, capped at 300% of your spell power per enemy. Eligibility is checked on each hit; switching or losing a link changes future contributions without erasing stored damage. Only the strongest eligible Conjunction records each hit; equal copies use the earliest application. At expiration each sigil releases its stored amount once as Shadow damage, without further vulnerability amplification. Echoes, periodic damage and retaliation never feed it.

nodes.name: Self-Renewing Script
nodes.description: A completed Mind Flay channel restores 1 charge to your active Ward of Correspondence, up to its original 6-charge limit. Does not revive an expired or depleted ward. This node also grants the base Ward ability if its node is not selected.

nodes.name: Accumulated Understanding
nodes.description: Casting Mind Blast reduces Unveil Weakness's remaining cooldown by 0.5 / 1 second. Echoes and secondary hits do not trigger this reduction.

nodes.name: Enduring Communion
nodes.description: Increase Mind Sear: Communion's base link duration from 30 to 40 seconds and its maximum remaining duration after extensions from 45 to 55 seconds. Existing links gain no time immediately when this talent is selected. Occult Diagnosis grants 1 Insight when applied. Also grants the base Diagnosis ability if its node is not selected; selecting both does not duplicate it.

nodes.name: Protective Geometry
nodes.description: Enemies bearing your Grand Conjunction deal 5% less damage to your party while the sigil lasts. Only the strongest copy of this reduction applies.

nodes.name: Disquieting Truth
nodes.description: Completing Mind Flay on a non-boss enemy interrupts its current cast. Can occur once every 20 seconds per enemy. Bosses are not interrupted by this talent.

nodes.name: Reproach of the Seal
nodes.description: Increase Ward of Correspondence's retaliation damage by 15% / 30%. This retaliation remains personal damage, not an allied stat buff, and cannot feed delayed effects.

nodes.name: Hammer of the Hidden Name
nodes.description: Mind Blast deals 15% more direct damage to enemies bearing your Unveil Weakness. This personal modifier is not shared through Communion and does not strengthen the enemy vulnerability itself.

nodes.name: Interwoven Axioms
nodes.description: Reduce the base cooldowns of Unveil Weakness, Ward of Correspondence and Grand Conjunction by 10%. Does not affect Mind Blast or Occult Diagnosis recharge times.

nodes.name: Seamless Communion
nodes.description: Reduce Mind Sear: Communion's charge recharge time from 12 to 9 seconds. Applying or refreshing a link reduces that ally's threat generation by 50% for 8 seconds, refreshing rather than stacking. Does not remove existing threat, increase the two-ally limit, or extend any enemy mark.

nodes.name: Deep Reading
nodes.description: Each completed Mind Flay channel on a target bearing your Unveil Weakness increases your next Mind Blast's direct damage against that target by 10%, stacking up to 3 times for 10 seconds. Mind Blast consumes all stacks. Switching targets does not transfer this reading.

nodes.name: Law of Correspondence
nodes.description: Direct hits from you and your currently eligible Communion allies against your Occult Diagnosis have a 10% chance to produce a Shadow echo equal to 15% of that hit's damage before Thaumaturgy bonuses. Only the strongest eligible Diagnosis may trigger this; equal copies use the earliest application. Maximum one echo per second per diagnosed enemy across all Thaumaturges. Unlinked players cannot trigger your echo. Echoes cannot trigger or feed echoes and are attributed to the diagnosing Priest.

nodes.name: Inscription of Frailty
nodes.description: Your Shadow Word: Pain increases damage its target takes from you and your eligible Communion allies by an additional 1% while your Unveil Weakness is also active on it. This bonus ends when either effect ends and follows the combined 15% cap. Unlinked players do not benefit.

nodes.name: Doctrine of Diminishment
nodes.description: Enemies bearing your Unveil Weakness deal 3% less damage to your party. Only the strongest copy applies. This reduction adds to Protective Geometry when both are active, rather than increasing party stats.

nodes.name: Stillness of the Adept
nodes.description: Channel for 3 seconds, reducing Unveil Weakness, Ward of Correspondence and Grand Conjunction's remaining cooldowns by 2 seconds each per completed tick. Three ticks before haste. Generates no Insight, extends no weaknesses and does not reduce its own cooldown.

nodes.name: Rupture of the Sacred Pattern
nodes.description: Casting Grand Conjunction also deals one Mind Blast-strength Shadow hit to each sigil target without spending Insight or consuming Mind Blast charges. These ritual hits do not count as Mind Blast casts, trigger echoes, or feed the sigil's stored damage.

nodes.name: Mercy Through Communion
nodes.description: A direct Flash Heal or Benediction of the Inner Light cast on an ally bearing your active Communion extends that ally's existing link by 2 seconds, up to its remaining-duration cap, and grants an 8-second absorb equal to 5% of your maximum health. Can trigger once every 3 seconds across all allies. Reapplications replace the absorb. Secondary, periodic and triggered healing cannot trigger this talent. Expired links are not recreated; enemy marks are not extended.

nodes.name: A Moment Outside the World
nodes.description: Each Stillness of the Adept tick reduces its affected cooldowns by an additional 1 second, for a total of 9 seconds across a completed channel.

nodes.name: Inevitable Conclusion
nodes.description: After Grand Conjunction, your next 3 Mind Blasts within 12 seconds cost 1 less Insight. This reduction cannot make a spell refund Insight; free-cast effects take precedence.

nodes.name: As Above, So Below
nodes.description: Applying Ward of Correspondence increases your active Doctrine of Diminishment reduction by an additional 1% / 2% for 8 seconds. If Doctrine is not selected, this node grants its base 3% reduction on Unveil Weakness targets before applying the temporary bonus. Duplicate copies never stack.

nodes.name: Restorative Mysteries
nodes.description: Increase Flash Heal and Benediction of the Inner Light healing by 5% / 10%.

nodes.name: Fragments of the Hidden Name
nodes.description: When a completed Mind Flay channel extends Unveil Weakness, gain a Fragment, up to 3. Your next Mind Blast consumes all Fragments and extends your active Unveil Weakness on its target by an additional 1 second per Fragment. Fragments last 15 seconds and cannot revive expired revelations.

nodes.name: The Great Work
nodes.description: While at least one enemy bears your Unveil Weakness, you gain 8% haste. Multiple marked enemies do not stack the bonus. This is personal casting speed, not a stat increase granted to allies.

nodes.name: Consolation of the Veil
nodes.description: Your Flash Heal and Benediction of the Inner Light leave a 6-second healing effect equal to 20% of their effective primary healing. On the same ally, reapplication replaces this effect instead of stacking it. Periodic healing cannot trigger another Consolation.

nodes.name: Esoteric Combat
nodes.description: Mind Flay and Mind Sear summon an unseen reflection of your consciousness to channel the spell in your stead. While your reflection channels, you can move and cast other spells freely.

nodes.name: Mastery: Exploit Weakness
nodes.description:
Your damaging spells expose hidden weaknesses in their target, building an Exploitation reserve equal to [Mastery %] of the damage dealt.

Whenever you or an eligible Mind Sear: Communion ally damages that target, the reserve inflicts additional damage equal to the triggering hit, up to the amount remaining. This additional damage is attributed to you and consumes an equal amount of reserve.

Additional applications add to the reserve. Mastery-generated damage, echoes, stored-damage detonations and retaliation cannot build or trigger the reserve.

nodes.name: Exploiter
nodes.description: The target of your Unvail Weakness gain 20% more Exploit Weakness

nodes.name: Aura of Decay
nodes.description: Every 5 seconds, enemies within 15 feet of you gain an Exploitation reserve equal to 2% / 4% of their current health, up to 100% / 200% of your spell power per enemy per pulse.

nodes.name: Crusing Soul
nodes.description:
If you have 5 or more Insight, consume 5 insight to grant the target (5000%sp) exploit weakness.

Can trigger 1 every minute

nodes.name: Akashic Imprint
nodes.description:
Expending Insight creates an Akashic apparition for 15seconds. 
Akashic apparition despair the target of your Crushing Strike increasing it's unvail weakness effect by 2% per apparition

nodes.name: Step Between Symbols
nodes.description: Fade removes movement slows and reduces damage you take by 10% for 3 seconds. It does not teleport you or break roots and stuns.

nodes.name: Moment of Gnosis
nodes.description: Hermetic Focus grants you 15% haste for 8 seconds. If Hermetic Focus is not selected, casting Grand Conjunction grants this benefit instead. The two triggers refresh rather than stack it.

nodes.name: Resonance of the Unspoken
nodes.description: When an Akashic apparition expire it resonate dealing  (100% sp) damage to enemy in range

nodes.name: Shelter Beyond the Veil
nodes.description: While Moment of Gnosis is active, you take 3% less damage per Akashic apparition.

nodes.name: Waymarks of the Unseen
nodes.description: Fade leaves a waymark at your location for 6 seconds. The first party ally to touch it has movement slows removed and becomes immune to slows for 3 seconds. An ally can benefit only once every 10 seconds. Roots and stuns are unaffected.

nodes.name: Threads of Correspondence
nodes.description: Completing Mind Flay extends your existing Occult Diagnosis on that enemy by 1 second, up to 12 seconds remaining, and your existing Communion links by 1 second each, up to their talented base duration plus 15 seconds remaining. No Diagnosis or link is created or revived. Does not increase vulnerability strength or share personal haste.

nodes.name: Primacy of Understanding
nodes.description: Mind Blast grants 2% personal haste for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. A new cast refreshes the shared duration. Echoes and secondary hits grant no stacks.

nodes.name: Twice-Written Fate
nodes.description: Akashic Imprint has a 20% chance to resolve one additional time.

nodes.name: Confluence of Signs
nodes.description: Increase Moment of Gnosis's duration by 2 seconds. If Moment of Gnosis is not selected, a completed Mind Flay channel instead grants you 5% haste for 4 seconds; this fallback does not stack with itself.

nodes.name: Fractured Axiom
nodes.description: Each completed Mind Flay channel has a 15% chance to restore one Mind Blast charge, without exceeding its maximum. Channels interrupted before their final tick do not trigger this effect.

nodes.name: Crushing apparition
nodes.description: Crushing strike as a chance to consume 1 Insight and increase the duration of all Unvail Weakness by 3 seconds

nodes.name: Beyond the veil
nodes.description: Crushing Strike leaves an Akashic apparition when it dashes you.

nodes.name: Fading Apparition
nodes.description: Fade creates an Akashic apparition

designNotes.status: First playable-concept draft; talent descriptions only, not a combat simulation or implemented WoW specialization.
designNotes.identity: Hermetic rites, sacred geometry, divination and knowledge of hidden laws. Neither a Voidform spec nor an allied-stat buffer. Core direct damage is Shadow; restorative and warding rites are Holy.
designNotes.baselineSpells: Shadow Word: Pain, Flash Heal, Fade, Smite and Mind Sear: Communion are assumed to be known before talent selection. Communion is a baseline ability, not a talent point purchase; its rules are also displayed in Unveil Weakness's tooltip. Mind Flay and Mind Blast are unlocked by their specialization nodes. Mind Sear is a historical Priest spell name; its ally-link behavior here is an original homebrew reinterpretation, not its retail effect.

communionAbility.name: Mind Sear: Communion
communionAbility.description: Sear a fragment of your consciousness into another mind, sharing the hidden weaknesses you perceive. Connect a living friendly player in your party or raid for 30 seconds. Maintain at most two distinct allies; you are always eligible without occupying a link slot. Recasting on an existing ally refreshes their link; selecting a third replaces the oldest applied or refreshed link. Instant, Mana cost, 40-yard application range, two charges with sequential 12-second recharge, on the global cooldown. No channel is maintained and this spell deals no damage. Links do not share personal haste, personal damage modifiers, Insight or spell procs.

designNotes.communionRules: An ally's link timer continues while more than 60 yards from you, but its offensive benefits are suspended until they return. Death of either participant ends that link; leaving your party or raid ends it. Pets and guardians inherit their owner's eligibility and occupy no link slots. Eligibility is checked when each hit occurs, so changing links affects existing vulnerabilities immediately; changing links never creates, refreshes or extends an enemy mark. Link extensions affect only your existing unexpired links, never create or revive them, and cap remaining duration at the talented base duration plus 15 seconds. Reapplication resets duration to that base. Losing a link does not erase damage already recorded by Grand Conjunction.
designNotes.resource: Mana pays for spells. Insight is a separate resource, initially capped at 6. Mind Flay channels for 3 seconds with 3 ticks before haste, generating 1 Insight per tick. Mind Blast costs 2 Insight, has a 1.5-second cast and 2 charges with a 9-second recharge. Haste accelerates Mind Flay's channel; it does not add extra ticks. Insight cannot exceed its current cap.
designNotes.supportScope: Offensive support means you and up to two currently eligible Mind Sear: Communion allies, including their pets and guardians. Allies may be chosen across raid subgroups; unlinked players receive no offensive benefit from your marks. Environmental damage is excluded. This shares access to enemy vulnerability, not a second damage-done buff. Defensive or utility descriptions that say party continue to mean your current subgroup of up to five players and do not require Communion.
designNotes.weaknessRules: Unveil Weakness lasts 12 seconds, has a 30-second cooldown, affects at most 5 enemies including its primary target, and increases damage taken from eligible Communion contributors by 6%. Select nearest enemies within 8 yards of the primary target. Extension effects only extend your existing active Unveil Weakness; they never create it or revive an expired debuff. Remaining duration is capped at 20 seconds unless a talent explicitly changes this cap. A completed Mind Flay channel extends its target by 1 second; Mind Blast extends its target by 2 seconds.
designNotes.stackingAndLimits: For each attacker-enemy pair, different Thaumaturgy vulnerability families add together, capped at 15% total. Each named family uses only its strongest active application from a Priest for whom that attacker is currently eligible; ineligible applications cannot suppress an eligible one. Equal-strength ties use the earliest application. Effects enhancing a named vulnerability remain in that same family. Bonuses apply once and never multiply one another. Only the winning eligible Grand Conjunction records a hit; only the winning eligible Occult Diagnosis may trigger Law of Correspondence. This prevents overlapping Priests from recording or echoing the same hit multiple times.
designNotes.echoRules: Recorded damage is the eligible hit's amount before Thaumaturgy vulnerability bonuses. Echoes, stored-damage detonations and retaliation from Thaumaturgy never trigger, feed or record one another. Each delayed effect resolves once; it is cancelled if its target is no longer valid. Personal echoes can benefit from vulnerability once, but cannot create another echo.
designNotes.rankRules: Where a node has two ranks, slash-separated values give Rank 1 / Rank 2. Listed cooldown reductions stack additively and cannot reduce a cooldown below 1 second. Percentages and timings are initial tuning proposals.
designNotes.augmentationMapping: Ebon Might -> Unveil Weakness; Eruption -> Mind Blast; Upheaval -> Mind Flay; Blistering Scales -> Ward of Correspondence; Prescience -> Occult Diagnosis; Breath of Eons -> Grand Conjunction; Time Skip -> Stillness of the Adept. Chronowarden is reimagined as the original Akashic Seer hero path. The Evoker tree is unchanged.
designNotes.openDecisions: Selected-contributor support is now drafted through baseline Mind Sear: Communion. Link duration, range, recharge, vulnerability percentages, spell coefficients and resource tuning remain provisional. Whether to replace the adapted class tree with a faithful retail Priest baseline, Apex identity, and a second hero path remain open.

nodes.name: Moonkin Form
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Enter a caster form that supports your borrowed Balance toolkit. Illustrative benefit: 100% additional armor and access to Starfire. More armor is not equivalent to the same percentage of physical damage reduction. Starsurge and Sunfire are separate purchases. This is a form/toolkit switch, not an additional damaging cast.

nodes.name: Frenzied Regeneration
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. While in Bear Form, spend Rage to restore 20% of your maximum health over 3 seconds. This is self-healing, not an ally external. Numbers and charge rules are design assumptions.

nodes.name: Swiftmend
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Deliver a strong instant heal to a friendly target with one of your healing-over-time effects. This reference does not consume that effect. Adds an emergency healing button, not a defensive damage-reduction external.

nodes.name: Remove Corruption
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Remove Curse and Poison effects from a friendly target. Does not remove harmful Magic effects; the healer specialization would need its own magic-dispel rules.

nodes.name: Starsurge
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. A direct Astral strike for the borrowed caster toolkit. Balance uses its specialization resource rules; other specializations use a Mana-limited off-role version. No coefficient is asserted here.
nodes.cost: Astral Power for Balance; Mana off-role

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce all damage you take by 2% / 4%. This is always-on personal mitigation, not party-wide mitigation.

nodes.name: Improved Rejuvenation
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Rejuvenation healing by 10% / 20%. Improves one spell; it does not increase all healing done by this amount.

nodes.name: Natural Recovery
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase healing you receive by 4%. This is a personal recovery bonus, not a bonus to healing you deliver to allies.

nodes.name: Sunfire
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Apply a Nature damage-over-time effect to an enemy for 12 seconds. Adds a caster damage button. Multi-target application is unlocked separately by Improved Sunfire.

nodes.name: Feline Swiftness
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase movement speed by 8% / 15%. Does not stack additively with every other movement-speed effect.

nodes.name: Improved Regrowth
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase the direct healing of Regrowth by 10% / 20%. This example deliberately avoids claiming a current retail critical-strike rule.

nodes.name: Renewal
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Instantly restore 30% of your maximum health. Usable in shapeshift forms. This is a personal emergency heal.

nodes.name: Improved Sunfire
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Sunfire also applies its damage-over-time effect to up to 4 additional enemies within 8 yards of the primary target. Adds coverage, not another button.

nodes.name: Killer Instinct
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase physical damage dealt by 3% / 6%. A broad physical modifier; do not count this as 6% total throughput for a primarily magical specialization.

nodes.name: Nurturing Instinct
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase healing done by 3% / 6%. This reference uses a simple healing modifier rather than attempting to reproduce historical primary-stat conversion rules.

nodes.name: Verdant Heart
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Frenzied Regeneration healing by 20%. While Barkskin is active, increase healing received by 10%. Both benefits are personal and conditional.

nodes.name: Rake
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat Form, strike an enemy and apply a bleed, generating 1 combo point. This is a borrowed melee builder, not a reason to give every specialization a full Cat rotation.

nodes.name: Skull Bash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, close a short distance and interrupt the target, locking its interrupted spell school for 4 seconds. Shapeshift and range restrictions are intentional costs.

nodes.name: Soothe
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Remove Enrage effects from one enemy. This does not remove normal Magic buffs.

nodes.name: Cyclone
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Temporarily incapacitate an enemy for up to 6 seconds and make it immune to damage and healing. Subject to crowd-control immunity and diminishing returns; not an AoE stun.

nodes.name: Rip
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat Form, spend combo points to apply a finishing bleed. Duration scales with points spent. This completes an optional borrowed builder/spender pair with Rake.

nodes.name: Well-Honed Instincts
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. When you fall below 40% health, trigger a free Frenzied Regeneration. May occur once every 90 seconds. An automatic recovery effect, not a manually bound new button.

nodes.name: Improved Frenzied Regeneration
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Frenzied Regeneration recharge time by 6 seconds. Changes recovery frequency, not the amount of damage you can ignore.

nodes.name: Improved Remove Corruption
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Remove Corruption cooldown by 2 seconds. Does not add harmful Magic dispels. This is a proposed tuning node, not a verified retail talent name.

nodes.name: Swipe
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, deal physical damage to nearby enemies. Form-specific resource and specialization rules apply. Grants one borrowed AoE button, not two separate hotkeys.
nodes.cost: Energy in Cat Form; no resource in Bear Form

nodes.name: Stampeding Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase movement speed of nearby allies by 60% for 8 seconds. Briefly enters Bear Form if needed. Raid-capable movement utility, not damage reduction.

nodes.name: Typhoon
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Knock back enemies in front of you and daze them briefly. Positional control; knockback-immune enemies are not displaced.

nodes.name: Hibernate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Put a Beast or Dragonkin to sleep for up to 40 seconds. Damage breaks the effect. Restrictions make this a situational control tool.

nodes.name: Thrash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, damage nearby enemies and apply a bleed. Form-specific resource rules apply. Optional melee AoE damage, not another ranged spell.
nodes.cost: Energy in Cat Form; no resource in Bear Form

nodes.name: Improved Stampeding Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Stampeding Roar radius by 15 yards and reduce its cooldown by 30 seconds. Extends access and frequency, not the speed bonus.

nodes.name: Ursol's Vortex
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Create a 10-second vortex that slows enemies in its area by 50% and pulls each eligible enemy back once when it first leaves. Does not repeatedly pull the same enemy.

nodes.name: Mass Entanglement
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Root a target and nearby enemies for up to 20 seconds. Damage can break the roots. Root immunity and diminishing returns still apply.

nodes.name: Lycara's Teachings
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Gain a form-dependent bonus: 2% / 4% critical strike in caster form, haste in Cat Form, versatility in Bear Form, or mastery in Moonkin Form. Only the current form bonus applies. These illustrative values are not current retail data.

nodes.name: Ursine Vigor
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 4 seconds after entering Bear Form, gain an additional 15% armor and 10% maximum health. A temporary form-based survival tool; not constant mitigation.

nodes.name: Innervate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Allow a friendly healer to cast without Mana costs for 10 seconds. This is a resource external, not damage reduction, immunity, or a direct damage buff.

nodes.name: Improved Innervate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. When Innervate is used on another healer, you also receive 50% Mana-cost reduction for its duration. Proposed self-benefit; does not create another external.

nodes.name: Heart of the Wild
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 45 seconds, substantially improve activities outside your specialization: illustrative 20% off-role damage or healing and stronger Bear survival. Your own specialization throughput is not increased. One role-switch cooldown, not several new rotational buttons.

nodes.name: Incapacitating Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Enter Bear Form and incapacitate nearby enemies for 3 seconds. Damage breaks the effect. This is a stop, not a long-duration AoE stun.

nodes.name: Mighty Bash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Stun one enemy for 4 seconds. Usable in shapeshift forms. Stun immunity and diminishing returns still apply.

nodes.name: Nature's Vigil
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 20 seconds, a portion of your eligible single-target damage heals a nearby injured ally, or your eligible healing deals damage to a nearby enemy. Illustrative conversion: 10%, at most one conversion per original event; conversions cannot trigger conversions. Does not grant an ally a damage-taken reduction.

nodes.name: Protector of the Pack
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Store 5% of your eligible damage or effective healing, up to 10% of maximum health. Your next Regrowth consumes that store to add healing. Stored bonus healing cannot store itself again.

nodes.name: Oakskin
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Barkskin reduces damage taken by an additional 5 percentage points and lasts 2 seconds longer. This modifies one cooldown; it is not 5% permanent damage reduction.

nodes.name: Fluid Form
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Using Rake or Rip shifts you into Cat Form; using Frenzied Regeneration shifts you into Bear Form; using Starsurge shifts you into Moonkin Form. The relevant spell must already be learned. Convenience does not grant the spells or remove resource restrictions.

nodes.name: Forestwalk
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After casting Regrowth, gain 20% movement speed for 4 seconds. Refreshes rather than stacking with itself. A short conditional movement bonus.

nodes.name: Moonkin Form
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Enter a caster form that supports your borrowed Balance toolkit. Illustrative benefit: 100% additional armor and access to Starfire. More armor is not equivalent to the same percentage of physical damage reduction. Starsurge and Sunfire are separate purchases. This is a form/toolkit switch, not an additional damaging cast.

nodes.name: Frenzied Regeneration
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. While in Bear Form, spend Rage to restore 20% of your maximum health over 3 seconds. This is self-healing, not an ally external. Numbers and charge rules are design assumptions.

nodes.name: Swiftmend
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Deliver a strong instant heal to a friendly target with one of your healing-over-time effects. This reference does not consume that effect. Adds an emergency healing button, not a defensive damage-reduction external.

nodes.name: Remove Corruption
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Remove Curse and Poison effects from a friendly target. Does not remove harmful Magic effects; the healer specialization would need its own magic-dispel rules.

nodes.name: Starsurge
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. A direct Astral strike for the borrowed caster toolkit. Balance uses its specialization resource rules; other specializations use a Mana-limited off-role version. No coefficient is asserted here.
nodes.cost: Astral Power for Balance; Mana off-role

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce all damage you take by 2% / 4%. This is always-on personal mitigation, not party-wide mitigation.

nodes.name: Improved Rejuvenation
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Rejuvenation healing by 10% / 20%. Improves one spell; it does not increase all healing done by this amount.

nodes.name: Natural Recovery
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase healing you receive by 4%. This is a personal recovery bonus, not a bonus to healing you deliver to allies.

nodes.name: Sunfire
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Apply a Nature damage-over-time effect to an enemy for 12 seconds. Adds a caster damage button. Multi-target application is unlocked separately by Improved Sunfire.

nodes.name: Feline Swiftness
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase movement speed by 8% / 15%. Does not stack additively with every other movement-speed effect.

nodes.name: Improved Regrowth
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase the direct healing of Regrowth by 10% / 20%. This example deliberately avoids claiming a current retail critical-strike rule.

nodes.name: Renewal
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Instantly restore 30% of your maximum health. Usable in shapeshift forms. This is a personal emergency heal.

nodes.name: Improved Sunfire
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Sunfire also applies its damage-over-time effect to up to 4 additional enemies within 8 yards of the primary target. Adds coverage, not another button.

nodes.name: Killer Instinct
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase physical damage dealt by 3% / 6%. A broad physical modifier; do not count this as 6% total throughput for a primarily magical specialization.

nodes.name: Nurturing Instinct
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase healing done by 3% / 6%. This reference uses a simple healing modifier rather than attempting to reproduce historical primary-stat conversion rules.

nodes.name: Verdant Heart
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Frenzied Regeneration healing by 20%. While Barkskin is active, increase healing received by 10%. Both benefits are personal and conditional.

nodes.name: Rake
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat Form, strike an enemy and apply a bleed, generating 1 combo point. This is a borrowed melee builder, not a reason to give every specialization a full Cat rotation.

nodes.name: Skull Bash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, close a short distance and interrupt the target, locking its interrupted spell school for 4 seconds. Shapeshift and range restrictions are intentional costs.

nodes.name: Soothe
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Remove Enrage effects from one enemy. This does not remove normal Magic buffs.

nodes.name: Cyclone
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Temporarily incapacitate an enemy for up to 6 seconds and make it immune to damage and healing. Subject to crowd-control immunity and diminishing returns; not an AoE stun.

nodes.name: Rip
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat Form, spend combo points to apply a finishing bleed. Duration scales with points spent. This completes an optional borrowed builder/spender pair with Rake.

nodes.name: Well-Honed Instincts
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. When you fall below 40% health, trigger a free Frenzied Regeneration. May occur once every 90 seconds. An automatic recovery effect, not a manually bound new button.

nodes.name: Improved Frenzied Regeneration
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Frenzied Regeneration recharge time by 6 seconds. Changes recovery frequency, not the amount of damage you can ignore.

nodes.name: Improved Remove Corruption
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Remove Corruption cooldown by 2 seconds. Does not add harmful Magic dispels. This is a proposed tuning node, not a verified retail talent name.

nodes.name: Swipe
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, deal physical damage to nearby enemies. Form-specific resource and specialization rules apply. Grants one borrowed AoE button, not two separate hotkeys.
nodes.cost: Energy in Cat Form; no resource in Bear Form

nodes.name: Stampeding Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase movement speed of nearby allies by 60% for 8 seconds. Briefly enters Bear Form if needed. Raid-capable movement utility, not damage reduction.

nodes.name: Typhoon
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Knock back enemies in front of you and daze them briefly. Positional control; knockback-immune enemies are not displaced.

nodes.name: Hibernate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Put a Beast or Dragonkin to sleep for up to 40 seconds. Damage breaks the effect. Restrictions make this a situational control tool.

nodes.name: Thrash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. In Cat or Bear Form, damage nearby enemies and apply a bleed. Form-specific resource rules apply. Optional melee AoE damage, not another ranged spell.
nodes.cost: Energy in Cat Form; no resource in Bear Form

nodes.name: Improved Stampeding Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Stampeding Roar radius by 15 yards and reduce its cooldown by 30 seconds. Extends access and frequency, not the speed bonus.

nodes.name: Ursol's Vortex
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Create a 10-second vortex that slows enemies in its area by 50% and pulls each eligible enemy back once when it first leaves. Does not repeatedly pull the same enemy.

nodes.name: Mass Entanglement
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Root a target and nearby enemies for up to 20 seconds. Damage can break the roots. Root immunity and diminishing returns still apply.

nodes.name: Lycara's Teachings
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Gain a form-dependent bonus: 2% / 4% critical strike in caster form, haste in Cat Form, versatility in Bear Form, or mastery in Moonkin Form. Only the current form bonus applies. These illustrative values are not current retail data.

nodes.name: Ursine Vigor
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 4 seconds after entering Bear Form, gain an additional 15% armor and 10% maximum health. A temporary form-based survival tool; not constant mitigation.

nodes.name: Innervate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Allow a friendly healer to cast without Mana costs for 10 seconds. This is a resource external, not damage reduction, immunity, or a direct damage buff.

nodes.name: Improved Innervate
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. When Innervate is used on another healer, you also receive 50% Mana-cost reduction for its duration. Proposed self-benefit; does not create another external.

nodes.name: Heart of the Wild
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 45 seconds, substantially improve activities outside your specialization: illustrative 20% off-role damage or healing and stronger Bear survival. Your own specialization throughput is not increased. One role-switch cooldown, not several new rotational buttons.

nodes.name: Incapacitating Roar
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Enter Bear Form and incapacitate nearby enemies for 3 seconds. Damage breaks the effect. This is a stop, not a long-duration AoE stun.

nodes.name: Mighty Bash
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Stun one enemy for 4 seconds. Usable in shapeshift forms. Stun immunity and diminishing returns still apply.

nodes.name: Nature's Vigil
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 20 seconds, a portion of your eligible single-target damage heals a nearby injured ally, or your eligible healing deals damage to a nearby enemy. Illustrative conversion: 10%, at most one conversion per original event; conversions cannot trigger conversions. Does not grant an ally a damage-taken reduction.

nodes.name: Protector of the Pack
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Store 5% of your eligible damage or effective healing, up to 10% of maximum health. Your next Regrowth consumes that store to add healing. Stored bonus healing cannot store itself again.

nodes.name: Oakskin
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Barkskin reduces damage taken by an additional 5 percentage points and lasts 2 seconds longer. This modifies one cooldown; it is not 5% permanent damage reduction.

nodes.name: Fluid Form
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Using Rake or Rip shifts you into Cat Form; using Frenzied Regeneration shifts you into Bear Form; using Starsurge shifts you into Moonkin Form. The relevant spell must already be learned. Convenience does not grant the spells or remove resource restrictions.

nodes.name: Forestwalk
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After casting Regrowth, gain 20% movement speed for 4 seconds. Refreshes rather than stacking with itself. A short conditional movement bonus.

nodes.name: Obduracy
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Gain 2% avoidance against area damage and 2% movement speed. Avoidance is not a universal 2% damage reduction.

nodes.name: Divine Purpose
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Your eligible Holy Power spenders have a 10% chance to make the next eligible spender free and 10% stronger. Consume the proc once; free casts cannot trigger this proc again in this reference. Role eligibility is specialization-defined.

nodes.name: Avenging Wrath
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. For 20 seconds, increase your damage and healing by 20%. This model grants one shared cooldown; each specialization may replace or modify it. It is not a buff applied to allied players.

nodes.name: Turn Evil
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Fear one Undead or Demon for up to 40 seconds. Damage can break the effect. Restricted control rather than a universal ranged interrupt.

nodes.name: Divine Toll
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Trigger your role's signature spell on up to 5 appropriate nearby targets: Holy Shock for Holy, Avenger's Shield for Protection, or Judgment for Retribution. Requires that specialization's signature spell. Grants one burst button, not all three spells to every role.

nodes.name: Seal of Might
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. During Avenging Wrath, gain 2% / 4% mastery. Conditional stat benefit; not permanent 4% damage or healing.

nodes.name: Sanctified Wrath
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Avenging Wrath duration by 5 seconds. The damage/healing percentage remains unchanged. An uptime modifier, not another cooldown button.

nodes.name: Judgment of Light
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Judgment marks an enemy with 10 healing charges for 20 seconds. Eligible allied attacks consume one charge to heal that attacker; each attacker may trigger at most once per second. Small shared sustain, not a damage amplifier or defensive external.

nodes.name: Afterimage
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After spending 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory delivers a second heal at 30% strength to another nearby injured ally. The additional heal cannot trigger Afterimage again. Requires access to Word of Glory.

nodes.name: Healing Hands
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Word of Glory healing by up to 10% / 20% based on the target's missing health. This reference omits historical role-dependent Lay on Hands interactions rather than asserting current retail rules.

nodes.name: Lightforged Blessing
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. An eligible specialization spender heals you and up to 2 nearby injured allies for a small amount. Illustrative cap: 1% of your maximum health per ally, at most once every 3 seconds. Your role defines the eligible spender. No new button.

nodes.name: Punishment
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. A successful Rebuke automatically applies a reduced-strength Judgment to its target. May occur once per interrupt cooldown. A small reward for doing utility, not a second interrupt or a new attack hotkey.

nodes.name: Holy Aegis
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase armor by 10% / 20% and critical strike chance by 1% / 2%. Armor affects physical damage only; this does not mean 20% less total damage.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Spirit
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Lay on Hands cooldowns by 20%. Does not affect Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice in this reference. Stacks multiplicatively after flat Lay on Hands reductions.

nodes.name: Sanctified Plates
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase armor by 10% / 20%, maximum health by 2% / 4%, and reduce area damage taken by 2% / 4%. These are different defensive dimensions, not an additive universal damage reduction.

nodes.name: Of Dusk and Dawn
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After generating 6 Holy Power, your next eligible spender is 10% stronger. After consuming that bonus, gain 3% damage reduction for 6 seconds. One pending bonus at a time. This is a simplified generator/spender cadence, not an exact retail implementation.

nodes.name: Seal of Order
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase the Dusk and Dawn spender bonus by 5 percentage points and its defensive duration by 2 seconds. Does not create another separately stacking damage buff.

nodes.name: Strength of Conviction
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. While you stand in Consecration, increase your Word of Glory healing by 10% / 20%. Does not reduce damage taken by 20%; it improves one situational heal.

nodes.name: Faith in the Light
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After Word of Glory, reduce physical damage you take by 5% for 4 seconds. A simplified personal follow-up defense, replacing role-specific historical block mechanics in this reference.

nodes.name: Improved Blessing of Protection
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Reduce Blessing of Protection cooldown by 60 seconds. Retains Forbearance, physical-only coverage and threat caveats. This is a proposed reference modifier, not verified retail allocation.

nodes.name: Touch of Light
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Your spells and abilities occasionally produce a small additional heal or Holy hit. Proposed rule: at most one trigger per 10 seconds; proc events cannot trigger themselves. An automatic throughput proc, not a button.

nodes.name: Seal of Mercy
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Increase Golden Path healing by 50%. If Golden Path restores 1% maximum health per tick, this raises it to 1.5%, not 51%. No new healing aura is granted.

nodes.name: Recompense
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. Store 10% of damage you actually suffer through Blessing of Sacrifice, capped at 5% maximum health. Your next Judgment or Word of Glory consumes the store to add damage or healing. Stored effects cannot generate more stored damage.

nodes.name: Divine Resonance
nodes.description: MEMORY-INSPIRED REFERENCE; provisional rules and numbers, not verified retail. After Divine Toll, repeat one eligible signature cast every 5 seconds for 15 seconds. Each repeat uses valid role-appropriate targeting and cannot trigger another resonance. Extends one existing button; it does not add a button.

designNotes.status: Synthetic memory-inspired class-only brainstorming baseline; not an official tree or a balance simulation.

alreadyKnown: Word of Glory through role rules
baselineAssumptions.spellNotes: For this design model only. Holy Power generation, spenders and Word of Glory availability require specialization rules. Divine Shield and Divine Protection are personal; Devotion Aura is a persistent group benefit. Intercession is the combat resurrection. Do not count these assumed baseline spells as talent-granted new buttons.
excludedSpecializationTools: Holy Shock / Avenger's Shield / Templar's Verdict / Divine Storm as shared-class unlocks
baselineAssumptions.allocationCaveat: Divine Toll, Avenging Wrath, Divine Purpose and several named modifiers have role-dependent or expansion-dependent placement. Shared placement here is a deliberate synthetic comparison, not a verified current retail allocation. Historical choice nodes are shown independently; no retail exclusivity is claimed.

designNotes.graphRules: Sparse forward prerequisite links only; all other nodes are roots. This is not a reconstructed retail path graph. No 8/20-point gates or level requirements are asserted. There are no encoded choice nodes, auto-granted ranks or import strings for the game.
designNotes.tuningRules: Slash-separated values are Rank 1 / Rank 2. Listed values are provisional examples. Cooldown reductions are additive except where explicitly described otherwise. No cooldown may fall below 1 second. Effective healing excludes overhealing. Baseline cooldown, resource and proc interactions need testing before implementation.
